data.readmeSummary:
## Web to Markdown

A fast, HTTP-only extractor that converts web pages into compact, LLM-ready Markdown by extracting main article content and page metadata without running a headless browser. The Actor performs readability-first content extraction with fallbacks to article/main/body, strips navigation, scripts, styles, footers, asides and forms, absolutizes links, and truncates Markdown to a bounded length (default ~20,000 characters). It also fetches page-level metadata (title, meta/OG description, author, published time), reports final URL after redirects and HTTP status, provides a per-page character count, and returns per-page success/failure information. Fetch behavior is HTTP-only with a browser-like User-Agent, redirect following and a request timeout; hosts that resolve to private, loopback or link-local IPs are blocked as an SSRF protection. Designed for batch conversion and low-latency calls suitable for integration into automated agent flows and RAG pipelines.

## Use cases

- Produce compact, clean Markdown versions of web pages for AI agents and conversational agents.
- Prepare page text for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows and vectorization.
- Extract article-centric content and metadata (title, description, author, publish date) for indexing and search.
- Batch-convert many URLs with per-page success/failure reporting and bounded output size.
- Rapid, browserless page conversion to embed page text into prompts or downstream NLP pipelines.
